subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw move provider usage collection from a closed core provider list to plugin-owned discovery, and what additive structured billing fields should the Usage dashboard consume?
rationale: The gap is source-proven, but the permanent contract crosses public plugin APIs, provider auth semantics, external billing data, and Control UI product behavior; the protected `maintainer` label also requires explicit human direction.

options.title: Define Additive Provider Billing Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify plugin discovery, typed billing fields, UI stale/error states, and provider proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Dashboard Usage Status
options.body: Limit the first step to optional `usage.status` display using the existing free-form snapshot shape, and track typed billing separately.

options.title: Defer Provider Billing Surface
options.body: Leave provider billing outside the Usage dashboard for now and keep CLI/status/plugin-specific surfaces as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Define Additive Provider Billing Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify plugin discovery, typed billing fields, UI stale/error states, and provider proof requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to both the provider usage hook history and current Usage dashboard work, making them the best available owner for this API/product direction choice.
